top_signals.summary:

top_signals.title: Wind Farm Approved in Victoria, Australia Would Be Largest in Southern Hemispher
top_signals.summary: A massive wind farm in the state of Victoria, Australia, has been approved by state authorities, paving the way for the project to go to the federal environment minister for final checks. ABC News reports Planning Minister Sonya Kilkenny this week signed off on the Warracknabeal Energy Park, five months after its environmental impact report was approved.
